name: Ab S.a.
summary: Established in 1990 and headquartered in Magnice, Poland, AB S.A. is a prominent player in the IT distribution sector, primarily serving markets across Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia. Beyond its core IT product distribution, AB S.A. boasts a diverse operational portfolio, including the assembly, wholesale, retail, import, export, and repair of a wide range of electronic equipment, encompassing computers, telecommunications devices, multimedia products, and other electronics. Further diversifying its offerings, the company engages in software development and trading, as well as the installation of IT networks and the implementation of comprehensive computer systems. AB S.A. also provides premises rental services and operates bonded warehouses, supporting its logistical framework. Its extensive service array covers internet provisioning, maintenance, IT consulting, and logistics solutions such as forwarding and transportation. Additionally, the company offers educational initiatives through training and publication services, alongside printing, promotion, advertising, and marketing support.
